analyst_view.overall: Early view: CSKA Sofia (28th, one point) have lost narrowly to Monaco (2-1) and at Panathinaikos (2-1) and drew 2-2 at Nordsjælland, so they have been competitive without winning. Trabzonspor (12th, six points) are third in the Turkish Süper Lig with the league's best goal difference, though they lost 1-0 at home to Freiburg last time. CSKA need a win to stay in the hunt for the play-offs.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.8 goals. I lean a little higher: every one of CSKA's three games has produced at least three goals, and they have scored in all of them. Trabzonspor score freely in Turkey (24 goals in ten league games) and won 4-2 at KuPS.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.1 corners, split evenly. I read nothing on either side's wide play that moves this.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.6 cards. A full Balgarska Armia against a big Turkish club will be lively, but the number already sits fairly high and there is no referee yet.

shots.text: The numbers say 29.5 shots. Both sides have been attacking in their games, which fits a high count; nothing pushes me off the number.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.4 shots on target. With both teams scoring regularly, a healthy count fits; I stay with the number.
